statements.text: Limit Percent: This is the percentage you are allowed to receive or deliver more against the quantity ordered. For example: If you have ordered 100 units, Supplier sends 120 units and the percentage is set to 10% then you are allowed to receive 110 units. By default, this is set to 0.
Role Allowed to Over Deliver/Receive: Users with this role are allowed to over deliver/receive against orders above the allowance percentage.

reason: Visible source contains explicit quantity-allowance and authorized-role exception statements for over delivery/receipt, matching the target objective for Purchase Receipt qty validation.
